caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing and dressed in historical clothing. She is wearing a long, light-colored dress with vertical stripes and a pattern of small red and blue flowers, accompanied by a light blue belt. Over her dress, she has a long burgundy cape with gold trim that covers her shoulders and extends down toward her calves. She is wearing a matching burgundy bonnet on her head, with dark curled hair visible underneath. At her neck is a small, dark blue bow. Under the hem of her dress, frilled white undergarments reach mid-calf, and her feet are clad in brown shoes with red bows. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller profile illustration of a woman’s head and shoulders, showing a side view of the hairstyle, which is grayish black, parted in the middle, and gathered in a bun at the back. The background is plain off-white. The drawing is signed "F. Romano" near the bottom right.
title: Doll - "Narcissa Savery"
